title: Chapter 243 Ni Wu Escapes
content:
Chapter 243 Ni Wu Escapes

More than half of the cavalry were equipped with dazzling golden armor, which was very imposing.

The members of the Iron Sword Gate usually only focused on improving their personal strength, and there was no teamwork at all.

When they saw the cavalry rushing over, they were all shocked!

Many people began to retreat. Although they did not collapse, no one wanted to be the first to face the cavalry charge.

"Don't retreat, everyone get together and resist the cavalry charge." Ni Wu did not expect that there would be such a cavalry in Wana Village.

More than 90 guards moved quickly, holding big swords in their hands and ready to fight.

But the whole formation was not regular, the number of guards was too small, and several of them died. Many members of the Iron Sword Gate were still exposed on the periphery.

Of course, Ayub also knew that it was unwise to confront the guards directly.

So he specially chose a relatively weak place to break through.

The entire golden fire cavalry, like a red-hot sword, inserted into the wax block and quickly chiseled a huge crack through the crowd of the Iron Sword Gate.

No one can stop such a torrent of steel.

Wang Shuo stood on the tower with a smile on his face.

With just one attack, the people of the Iron Sword Gate felt what it meant to be invincible.

Even if they had soldiers as high as level 60, it would be useless.

"Contract defense."

Ni Wu was still smart and knew how to fight against cavalry.

However, his men had not been trained in formation. More than 3,000 people gathered together, like a group of sheep cuddling together, at the mercy of others.

If they could form a circle, the Golden Fire Cavalry might not be able to break through their formation.

If they used long spears to form a formation, the Golden Fire Cavalry would probably suffer heavy losses.

However, they all used swords and swords as weapons, and even had few shields, and they had no systematic training on how to fight against organized armies.

Ni Wu was also anxious.

Looking at the panicked crowd, everyone wanted to squeeze in the middle!

The second charge came soon.

Ayub also saw the dense crowd of the other side, and was worried that he could not break through, so he chose to insert from the edge.

In this way, the other side was even more dense.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he saw the people of Tiejianmen, like mice caught in the rain, huddled together.

He immediately ordered the soldiers of the crossbow battalion to shoot at the dense crowd.

"Bang, bang"

The shells of the catapult exploded in the crowd, and dozens of people fell to the ground with serious injuries.

The black iron spears covered the firepower, and the crowd fell like wheat being cut.

After a round of attacks, Ni Wu finally panicked.

He had experienced many battles, and this was the first time he felt so aggrieved.

Dispersing the formation would only become straw for the cavalry to harvest; shrinking the formation would become a target for the other side's long-range troops, which was really a dilemma.

"Get on the horse and break through." In the end, he made up his mind and chose to retreat.

After the battle reached this point, he had to accept this result.

In the end, he fled Wana Village with only more than 80 guards and hundreds of gang members.

Back at the Nanshanji Tiejianmen garrison, Ni Wu was furious.

He had never suffered such a terrible defeat before.

"Wang Shuo, I will not be a human being unless I kill you!"

As soon as he finished speaking, the people from the lord's mansion came, and Lin Guanru asked him to go to discuss matters.

Ni Wu knew that this defeat would definitely reach Lin Guanru's ears, and he couldn't escape it!

After venting for a while, he tidied his clothes and walked towards the lord's mansion.

"Mr. Mayor, I failed to collect taxes in Wana Village at this time, please punish me!"

Ni Wu was very humble and bowed to Lin Guanru.
